signals.text: Revenue grew 10% a year over 3 years vs 12% over 5: growth is steady.

Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 120% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

bull.point: Global consolidated revenues grew 11.9% to ₹ 582 Billion in FY26, driven by steady 16% growth in India formulations.
Global Innovative Medicines sales rose 12.8% to USD 351 million, now representing 21.9% of total company sales.
Company maintains an exceptionally strong balance sheet, being practically debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.06.
Strong cash conversion: over the last 5 years, operating cash flow reached 120% of reported net profit.

cite.table: Operating cash flow 120% of reported profit

bear.point: U.S. business remains challenged, with U.S. revenues declining by 4.1% and ongoing pricing pressures in generic drugs.
EBITDA margins face sequential headwinds, dropping to 28.9% in Q1 FY27 from 31.3% earlier due to rising costs.
Management guides only for high single-digit top-line growth for FY27, pointing to broader macroeconomic and regulatory headwinds.

cite.quote: We expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.

watch: Monitor progress and integration timelines for the Organon acquisition ahead of its expected Q4 FY27 close.
Track U.S. generic revenue stabilization and potential impacts from proposed import tariffs.
Evaluate specialty portfolio momentum, specifically the growth trajectory of Global Innovative Medicines.
